Member States may lay down rules governing the exemptions provided for in this Part. 2. Special provisions for cement kilns co-incinerating waste 2.1. The emission limit values set out in points 2.2 and 2.3 apply as daily average values for total dust, HCl, HF, NO x , SO 2 and TOC (for continuous measurements), as average values over the sampling period of a minimum of 30 minutes and a maximum of 8 hours for heavy metals and as average values over the sampling period of a minimum of 6 hours and a maximum of 8 hours for dioxins and furans. All values are standardised at 10 % oxygen. Half-hourly average values shall only be needed in view of calculating the daily average values. 2.2.
